title: Rupashree Prakalpa 2026: Status Check, Form, ₹25,000
meta_description: Rupashree Prakalpa 2026: ₹25,000 marriage grant for WB women. Check status at rupashree.wb.gov.in, eligibility, form, and why payments fail.

hero.one_liner: West Bengal's one-time ₹25,000 marriage grant for women from low-income families. How to check status, fill the form, and avoid the conditions that block payment.

what_is_it: Rupashree Prakalpa is a West Bengal government scheme that pays a one-time grant of ₹25,000 to women from low-income families at the time of their first marriage. It is run by the Women and Child Development and Social Welfare Department.
It was launched to ease the financial burden of marriage for poor families and to discourage child marriage. The money is paid directly to the bride's own bank account.
eligibility: Bride aged 18 or above on the marriage date, unmarried at application, and this must be her first marriage.
Permanent resident of West Bengal (born in WB, or resident 5+ years, or parents are permanent WB residents).
Family annual income from all sources not more than ₹1.5 lakh.
Bride must have her own NEFT-enabled bank account in her sole name.

eligibility_filters.notes: One-time marriage grant. Bride 18+, first marriage, groom 21+, WB resident, family income under ₹1.5 lakh.

steps.title: Open the official portal
steps.desc: Go to rupashree.wb.gov.in. Use only the official portal, not third-party sites, for accurate status.

extra_sections.heading: What Rupashree is and who runs it
content: Rupashree Prakalpa pays a one-time ₹25,000 to a woman from a low-income family for her first marriage. It is run by the Women and Child Development and Social Welfare Department of West Bengal.
The scheme exists to prevent two harms: the financial strain marriage puts on poor families, and child marriage. The age and income rules follow directly from those two goals.
The money reaches the bride's own bank account by direct transfer. It is unrestricted, so there is no need to prove how it was spent.

extra_sections.heading: Who qualifies for Rupashree
qualify: Bride aged 18 or above on the marriage date
It is the bride's first marriage and she is currently unmarried
Permanent West Bengal resident with family income under ₹1.5 lakh a year
Bride has her own NEFT-enabled bank account
disqualify: Family income above ₹1.5 lakh a year
Bank account not in the bride's own name

extra_sections.heading: Rupashree form: what to fill and where to get it
content: The form is available at any Bangla Sahayata Kendra, Gram Panchayat office, or Block office, and can be downloaded via bsk.wb.gov.in. Pick whichever is easiest to reach.
It asks for the bride's name, age, address and Aadhaar, plus the groom's name and age and the proposed marriage date. Every detail must match your documents, because the office cross-checks them.
Attach age proof, an income certificate, residence proof, a bank passbook copy and photographs. Missing or mismatched documents are the top reason for delay.

extra_sections.title: The 30 to 60 day window: the most common error
extra_sections.content:
The form must be submitted at least 30 days and no more than 60 days before the wedding. Submit at day 28 and it is rejected; submit at day 65 and it is also rejected.

Most families apply close to the wedding when things are already hectic. The 30-day minimum gives the office time to verify and approve before the ceremony.

Aim for the 40 to 50 day mark. That leaves a real buffer for document checks and payment.

extra_sections.heading: Why Rupashree payments fail after approval
content: The most frequent failure is Aadhaar not being seeded to the bank account. Payments go only to accounts where the Aadhaar-to-bank link is active in the NPCI mapper.
Check this before applying at myaadhaar.uidai.gov.in. If no active link shows, visit your bank and submit a consent form to receive DBT.
The second common failure is an account in a cooperative bank or post office that cannot receive these transfers. Use a regular NEFT-enabled bank account in the bride's own name.

extra_sections.text: Rupashree pays ₹25,000 once to the bride. It does not cover second marriages, income-ineligible families, non-residents of West Bengal, or marriages where the groom is under 21. These are the most common rejection reasons at district verification, not rare edge cases.

extra_sections.heading: After the wedding: what comes next
content: The ₹25,000 lands in the bride's bank account and can be used freely. The government does not track how it is spent.
To confirm the payment later, log in to rupashree.wb.gov.in or check your bank statement. The credit will show the government's name or a PFMS reference.
If payment has not arrived after approval, raise it with the BDO or municipal office where you applied, with your Applicant ID ready.

how_to_apply: Collect the form from a Bangla Sahayata Kendra, Gram Panchayat, Block Development Office, or download it via bsk.wb.gov.in.
Fill in the bride's details, the groom's name and age, and the proposed marriage date accurately.
Attach age proof, income certificate, residence proof, bank passbook copy, and photographs.
Submit at the local BDO, SDO, or Municipal office between 30 and 60 days before the wedding.
Collect the signed acknowledgement slip and note your Applicant ID to track status later.

faqs.question: How to check rupashree status 2026?
faqs.answer: Go to rupashree.wb.gov.in, click Search Applicant or Check Status, enter your Applicant ID and the application year, solve the CAPTCHA, and click Submit. Your status will show the current stage: submitted, under verification, approved, payment initiated, or paid.

faqs.question: What is the rupashree prakalpa scheme?
faqs.answer:
Rupashree Prakalpa is a West Bengal government scheme that gives a one-time grant of ₹25,000 to women from families with annual income below ₹1.5 lakh at the time of their first marriage. The money is paid directly to the bride's own NEFT-enabled bank account via DBT.

The bride must be 18+ and the groom 21+.

faqs.question: Where can I get the rupashree form PDF?
faqs.answer:
Download the form directly from bsk.wb.gov.in/download/RupashreeApplicationForm.pdf. You can also get a physical form from any Bangla Sahayata Kendra, Gram Panchayat office, or BSK centre in your district.

The same form is used for both urban and rural applications.

faqs.question: What is the income limit for rupashree prakalpa?
faqs.answer:
Family annual income from all sources must not exceed ₹1.5 lakh per year. This is the income of parents or guardian, not just one earning member.

The income is self-declared on the form in most cases, though some districts may ask for an income certificate from a government authority.

faqs.question: Why has my rupashree payment not come even though status shows approved?
faqs.answer:
Approval and payment are two separate steps. Payment can fail if your Aadhaar is not linked to your bank account (check at myaadhaar.uidai.gov.in/bank-seeding-status), if your bank does not support NEFT transfers, or if there is a name mismatch between your Aadhaar and bank account.

Visit your BSK with your Aadhaar and passbook to investigate.

faqs.question: Can a widow or divorced woman apply for rupashree prakalpa?
faqs.answer:
No. Rupashree Prakalpa applies only to first marriages. A woman who is a widow or divorced and remarrying is not eligible.

The eligibility condition specifically requires the woman to be unmarried at the time of application.

faqs.question: What if I submit the rupashree form too early or too late?
faqs.answer:
The form must be submitted between 30 and 60 days before the proposed marriage date. If you submit less than 30 days before, it will be rejected.

If you submit more than 60 days before, it is also rejected. If this happens, you need to resubmit within the valid window.

faqs.question: Can women from outside West Bengal who now live in WB apply for rupashree?
faqs.answer:
Yes, if they have been a resident of West Bengal for at least 5 consecutive years, or if their parents are permanent residents of West Bengal. Being born in West Bengal also qualifies.

A woman who recently moved to WB and has been here for less than 5 years may not qualify unless her parents are WB permanent residents.

faqs.question: How do I check my Rupashree status online?
faqs.answer: Go to rupashree.wb.gov.in and open the Search Applicant page. Enter your Applicant ID, the year and the captcha to see whether your application is pending, approved or paid.

faqs.question: How much is the Rupashree grant?
faqs.answer: It is a one-time grant of ₹25,000 paid directly to the bride's own bank account before the marriage.
